confirmed_facts: The top-level ledger regime field was written from EXIT features.
Entry regimes were correctly reconstructed from each immutable 1m prefix through its entry bar.
The original neutral-only entry fork relies on exit-regime attribution rather than a valid entry policy.
The entry range reference shows negative net R (-2.15) and a profit factor of 0.56.
causal_review.economic_assessment: The strategy's apparent performance under the exit regime attribution is illusory when evaluated from a genuine entry policy perspective, yielding negative net returns and poor drawdown characteristics.
fatal_method_errors: Using exit-feature regimes as a proxy for entry filters introduces lookahead bias and conflates exit attribution with entry rules.

red_team.false_positive_mechanism: Conflating post-entry exit-regime attribution with causal entry conditions, creating an illusory high profit factor (3.13) that collapses upon true entry-time evaluation (net R -2.15, PF 0.56).
fatal_blockers: Entry-time regime candidate displays negative net R (-2.15026)
Exit-neutral cohort is improperly treated as causal entry evidence
red_team.minimum_future_test: Re-evaluate entry policy strictly on forward-looking, entry-bar-locked feature definitions without relying on exit-feature regimes, ensuring positive net R and profit factor > 1 across all sub-windows.
red_team.why: The entry range reference clearly violates the criteria for allowing a temporary fork (net R < 0, profit factor < 1), confirming that the neutral entry fork must remain blocked due to lookahead bias and negative expected value.
